epistemic_scope: Published DES Y3 photometric lens-selection bins, NOT calibrated true n(z), observed shear residuals, or angular window functions. This is a pre-observational feasibility screen only.

archived_model_lock.chi_z_interpolation: linear in original 8 pairs of LW02 z and chi values; bracketing only; not new independent background precision

citations.lens_bins_and_measurement: DES Y3 MagLim galaxy clustering and GGL, https://www.darkenergysurvey.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/desy3_maglim2x2pt.pdf
citations.tomographic_mean_redshifts: DES Y3 high-redshift galaxy clustering and comparisons, https://academic.oup.com/mnras/article/525/3/3896/7244725
citations.lens_redshift_pdf: DES Y3 lens n(z) clustering-redshift calibration, https://academic.oup.com/mnras/article/513/4/5517/6594026
citations.harmonic_space_pseudo_Cl: DES Y3 galaxy clustering and galaxy-galaxy lensing in harmonic space, https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stae2654

geometry_rule.source: LW02 archived CLASS Newtonian-gauge background only
geometry_rule.ell_definition: integer ell where entire nominal photoz bin fits native z range, and k_h=(ell+0.5)/(h chi(z)) in [0.03,0.20] at all points of that nominal z interval

evaluation_policy.requires_calibrated_nz: Any real DES lens n(z) out-of-domain mass must be measured from a released n(z) kernel (not assumed zero at z_ph selection edges).
evaluation_policy.requires_windows: Any real DES gamma_t(theta) data bin requires a validated full Bessel angular response or documented pseudo-Cl bandpower window and leakage control. Finite ell support alone is insufficient.
evaluation_policy.note: A derived ell interval for photoz selection is NOT a valid angular scale cut for a measured gamma_t observable.

stop_rule: Read-only published metadata, exact SHA-parent and elementary geometry only. No observed data values, no change in physics, no new CLASS. Save conservative metadata-only conclusion even if many candidate bins geometrically overlap.
